subject.title: feat: Discord channel-per-agent binding display in Gateway UI (ZZ-20260311-005)

question: Which Gateway/UI surface should own read-only configured route and ACP binding visibility for the Agents channels panel?
rationale: The request adds a new core Gateway protocol read model and Control UI state path; current code has binding helpers but no maintainer-confirmed API namespace or UI ownership for this display.

options.title: Approve a normalized read model
options.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

options.title: Use existing config data
options.body: Have the UI derive the display from the existing config.get surface, accepting tighter coupling to raw config shape and avoiding a new RPC.

options.title: Defer the display
options.body: Keep bindings visible through config/docs for now and pause or close the linked implementation until a broader Control UI routing plan exists.

recommendation.title: Approve a normalized read model
recommendation.body: Define a stable read-only binding list contract, whether named routing.list or placed under an existing namespace, then review the linked implementation against that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses Gateway RPC policy and current read-only API patterns, where steipete has the strongest recent history signal.
